title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Timetable: Access Cutoff, Submission Cutoff and Delivery Times
content:
Timing terms of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, by tier.

| Tier | Access cutoff (business days before the payday on which access for that pay period closes) | Instant delivery standard (minutes) | Next-business-day submission cutoff (Eastern Time) | Next-business-day delivery (business days after the request date) | Instant transfers on weekends and Federal Reserve holidays | Next-business-day transfer can be cancelled before its submission cutoff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 2 | 30 | 17:00 | 1 | yes | yes |
| Paystride Access Standard | 2 | 30 | 17:00 | 1 | yes | yes |
| Paystride Access Plus | 2 | 30 | 17:00 | 1 | yes | yes |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 1 | 30 | 17:00 | 1 | yes | yes |
| Paystride Access Premier | 1 | 30 | 17:00 | 1 | yes | yes |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 1 | 30 | 17:00 | 1 | yes | yes |

## Definitions

- **Access cutoff** — the business days before the payday on which access for that pay period closes (count of business days).
- **Instant delivery standard** — the minutes within which an instant transfer must be delivered before its fee becomes refundable as late.
- **Next-business-day submission cutoff** — the Eastern Time after which a next-business-day request made on a business day is treated as made on the following business day (HH:MM).
- **Next-business-day delivery** — the business days after the request date on which a next-business-day transfer is delivered (count).
- **Weekend instant** — whether instant transfers run on weekends and Federal Reserve holidays.
- **Cancellation before cutoff** — whether a next-business-day transfer can be cancelled before its submission cutoff.

## Reading the timetable

The three lower tiers close access two business days before the payday and the three upper tiers one business day before it. Every other timing term is the same on all six tiers: a 30-minute instant delivery standard, a 17:00 Eastern Time submission cutoff, delivery one business day after the request date, instant transfers every day of the week, and cancellation of a next-business-day transfer before its submission cutoff.

**Hypothetical reading.** A next-business-day request on a business day at 16:40 Eastern Time is before the 17:00 cutoff and is treated as made that day; one at 17:25 is treated as made on the following business day.
